does: Rerolls dice already thrown, by a list of reroll conditions, on a freshly seeded generator of the stream; every new die is drawn from 1 to 20 whatever the faces given. Called only when an interrupt's SetReroll (Lucky, Indomitable, Second Chance) is resolved; it raises no roll event of its own.

evidence.says: The upper bound of the draw is the constant 20 and the faces argument is not used; its caller is on the path of using an interrupt
The upper bound of the draw is the constant 20 and the faces argument is not used; its only caller is esv::interrupt::ResolveRollAdjustmentsForRoll

one call when the host used Interrupt_Lucky_RollAdditionalDie on an attack of natural 3 (the hit then held natural 11); Ext.Events.Roll did not fire for the new die; zero calls over plain attacks, saves and damage

questions.ask: An interrupt that rerolls a die of a roll already made
